intent: Install fee[dB]ack (rhythm-gaming / music-education app) from a local-only pacman package, and stop local build artifacts from entering git history.
scope: .gitignore (build artifacts, Bottles prefixes, archwiki_rag vector index)
Non-goal: publishing to the AUR; this package is local-only
Non-goal: running the install itself — interactive sudo belongs to the user
changes: Added install_feedback.sh, which builds the package with makepkg and then prints the `sudo pacman -U` command rather than running it, matching the existing hypersomnia-appimage / jackify-bin pattern on this machine.
Added the PKGBUILD it builds from. options=(!strip) is required: stripping corrupts the AppImage's embedded ELF/squashfs layout.

Gitignored linux_configuration/scripts/single_use/*/*.pkg.tar.{zst,xz} (the built artifact here is ~640 MB), bottles/ (Wine prefixes) and digital_wellbeing/data/ (archwiki_rag's regenerable vector index). The PKGBUILD and installer remain tracked as the actual source.

Excluded PKGBUILD from the shellcheck hook. A PKGBUILD is a makepkg manifest, not a standalone script: it has no shebang by design, pkgname/pkgver/source/sha512sums are consumed by makepkg, and pkgdir/srcdir are injected by it, so shellcheck reports SC2148/SC2034/SC2154 for all of them. Same rationale as the pre-existing zsh exclusion — the dialect is outside what shellcheck can judge — and it avoids littering the file with per-line directives.
Deleted stray files: f.html (a saved SearXNG results page), kcd2_dice_solver/9 (0-byte, a stray shell redirect) and an i3 config.bak from June.

verification.evidence: Only 'PKGBUILD' is added; git check-ignore confirms the 666 MB .pkg.tar.zst is matched by .gitignore:374. Total staged diff is 139 lines, no binaries.
Block binary/image files, check for added large files, and all remaining hooks pass; shellcheck no longer reports the PKGBUILD false positives.

risks: The shellcheck PKGBUILD exclusion is repo-wide, so a future PKGBUILD is also unchecked. That is intended — shellcheck cannot meaningfully lint the format — but a genuinely broken PKGBUILD would fail at makepkg time rather than at commit time.
The gitignore glob is scoped to linux_configuration/scripts/single_use/*/ so it cannot silently swallow packages built elsewhere in the repo.
rollback: git revert the commit; the installer and PKGBUILD disappear and the ignore rules lift.
The built artifact is untracked either way, so nothing in the working tree needs restoring.
